問題 5  While your client has provided the Committee with posters of residents’ activities and events, notices, meeting agenda, sample application forms for Government subsidies in relation to MBIS renovation projects, newspaper articles, and other miscellaneous documents, it is noted that the following important categories of communications (notes, emails, WhatsApp messages or other records) are missing. Notably your client has provided the Committee with communication records with various OC members after their removal in October 2024, but has not provided any communications before that date, including (among others):

5.1  her communications with the former Chairman of the OC, Tang Kwok Kuen (鄧國權) and/or other OC members whether individually or collectively;

5.2  her communications with the contractors including the main contractor, Prestige Construction & Engineering Co., Limited (“PC&E”) and/or its directors, Mr. Hau Wa Kin and Mr. Ho Kin Yip; the consultants, Will Power Architects Company Limited (“WP”) and/or its director, Mr. Wong Hap Yin;

5.3  her communications with her district council colleagues and volunteers relating to Wang Fuk Court;

5.4  her communications with government departments relating to Wang Fuk Court; and

5.5  her communications with her political party members relating to Wang Fuk Court.

回答 4 及 5 通訊及紀錄

21.  針對委員會要求補充的通訊紀錄（第 5.1、5.3、5.4 及 5.5 項），由於本人多年來從事地區工作，手機內儲存了過千名聯絡人及超過六萬張相片，手機儲存空間不足。因此，本人的 WhatsApp 應用程式早於 2024 年 8 月已設定了「除已保留的訊息外，新訊息會在傳送 90 天後自動從對話中刪除」的功能。基於此技術原因，較早前的通訊紀錄已被系統自動刪除，本人並非刻意忘了保留。

22.  通訊乃雙向過程。如委員會已接觸其他持份者，亦請委員會向相關人士（如前主席鄧國權、袁生、陳凌滔、何慧蓮等）索取彼等所保留之完整通訊紀錄。如委員會取得有關紀錄並有進一步疑問，本人十分樂意在審閱後向委員會提供協助及解釋。

23.  本人澄清，本人已於早前提交的第一次回覆中，完整提供了「宏福苑好友群組」的 WhatsApp 文字備份紀錄（文件名稱為：與 Wfc 宏福苑友好的 WhatsApp 對話），而該群組對話中包含的所有照片、影片、表格等附件，亦已存放在同一個資料夾內一併呈交，並無任何遺漏。因為本人自 2024 年 10 月 10 日才被加進該群組，因此只有 2024 年 10 月 10 日以後的對話記錄。
